headline: Ownership Battles Intensify Across Three Fronts
war_summary: The latest ledger shows the struggle sharpening in several sectors, though the map remains divided between active assaults and quiet guns. WeatheredExpanseHex now leads the field with thirty-seven strategic-base events in twenty-four hours, thirteen in the latest six-hour span, and two in two hours; its holdings remain five Colonial, four Warden. FishermansRowHex follows with thirty-eight daily events, three in six hours, and none in the newest two-hour window, holding eight Colonial bases and one Warden. StlicanShelfHex has thirty-one daily events, three in six hours and three in the latest two, with six Warden and three Colonial bases. LinnMercyHex records eighteen daily events and two in six hours, while MooringCountyHex posts fifteen daily events but no event in the latest six-hour period. FarranacCoastHex, absent from the previous leading picture, has eleven daily events, though none recently. CallahansPassageHex remains the heaviest manpower furnace by casualties and enlistments, but its strategic ledger is still empty of ownership events. Several other regions show rising activity without recorded base changes.
